scope: ss 3, 3A (which classes of damages the Act's Parts do not reach: intentional and sexual harm, motor vehicle (CTP), workers' compensation common-law claims against the employer, tobacco, aviation, asbestos and silica), 4 (indexing, rounded to $500), 5A, 5B, 5E-5J (recreational activities, risk warnings, waivers), 5K-5L (contributory negligence, intoxication), 5N-5P (obvious and inherent risks), 6, 9 (general damages threshold, the band to Amount C and the s 9(3) middle band), 10, 11 (loss of earnings capped at 3 x AWE), 12, 13 (gratuitous home care). Out: Parts 1B-1F, Part 1A Div 7, s 13A, Part 2 Divs 4-5, Parts 2A and 3.
lives: jake k044 (2029-04-12): a car door fractures his wrist on a delivery; no workers' compensation for a contractor; a CTP claim against the driver's insurer
